newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-CROAT BUTOROVIC SIGNS WITH PORTO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROAT BUTOROVIC SIGNS WITH PORTO.

text.p: Croat international Darko Butorovic has signed a four-year contract with Portuguese champions Porto, a club source said on Thursday.
The club has already paid a transfer fee of $300,000 to Croatia's Hadjuk Split.

The defender could make his league debut for Porto on January 5 when they meet Guimaraes at home, but he will not be able to join his new side in European champions matches because he has already played for Split in a UEFA competition this season.
